topic: The Most Common Mistake Businesses Make With Their Website
hook: Your website was built once and never touched again. That is the mistake.
body: A website is not a brochure. It is your best salesperson — and if it has not changed in 2 years, it is actively losing you customers.
subtext: Outdated content, no mobile optimization, no clear CTA, no analytics. Each one costs you daily.
cta: Check your site today. When was it last updated?
caption:
Your website was built once and never touched again. That is the mistake.

A website is not a brochure. It is your best salesperson — working 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

If it has not been updated in 2 years:
— It probably loads slowly
— It probably looks broken on mobile
— It probably has no clear way for visitors to contact you
— It is definitely losing you customers

The businesses winning online treat their website like a product — always improving, always testing, always updating.

When was YOUR website last updated?
